newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera offer for Tabaqueira worth 30 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera offer for Tabaqueira worth 30 bln ptas.

text.p: The joint offer by Spain's Tabacalera and Portugal's Madeirense de Tabacos to buy 65 percent of Portuguese cigarette manufacturer Tabaqueira is worth 29.9 billion pesetas, Tabacalera said.

The offer was the highest at 5,610 escudos per share, compared with 5,100 escudos offered by the consortium formed by U.S. company Philip Morris and Portugal's Grupo Mello and with 4,800 from French company Seita.

"With this possible acquisition, the Tabacalera-Tabaqueira group is reinforcing its strategy of international expansion, consolidating itself as one of Europe's leading tobacco groups," Tabacalera said in a statement.
Tabaqueira has 75 percent of the Portuguese market share and sales worth 150 billion pesetas and provides opportunities for expansion in Africa, Brazil and Macao.
Tabacalera was trading up 40 pesetas to 5,530 at 0900 GMT.
